[P2] Allow partial collection after a verified no-work failure

A missing fixture makes `start()` delete the empty case, but the coordinator still calls `collect_partial()` after `NotImplementedError`. This lookup then raises, producing a cleanup error and quarantining the target despite successful retirement. `finish(quiescent=False)` retains the persistent fence, blocking subsequent cases and runs. Return empty partial evidence for verified no-work failures, or retain an explicit no-work state. Add a coordinator regression using the actual `SharedAdapter`; the missing-fixture coordinator test overrides `collect_partial()` and bypasses this defect.
